description:
This is a unit test class for the EmployeeEducation entity within the OrangeHRM project, testing the creation and persistence of EmployeeEducation records.
It sets up test data, persists entities, and verifies their properties via assertions.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for EmployeeEducation entity ensuring correct persistence and retrieval of education records for employees.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment; truncates specific database tables before each test.

methods.name: testEmployeeEducationEntity
methods.description: Creates employee and education entities, links them via EmployeeEducation, persists the data, retrieves it, and performs assertions to verify correctness.
